tagline: 2D pixel-art run-and-gun in the style of Contra / Broforce
summary: A movement-and-shooting prototype. The player controller is well done: run, sprint and sneak gaits, a tunable jump with coyote time, jump buffering and variable height, 8-way aiming, held-fire shooting, and distance-driven sprite animation with idle variants. Everything else that makes a run-and-gun a game is still missing: enemies, damage, death, a real tile-based level, HUD, audio and menus. The level is hard-coded rectangles, and bullets only collide with the world.

items: Run (default), sprint (Shift), sneak (P) with separate speeds
Optional acceleration and deceleration curves
Jump with coyote time, jump buffer, variable height (jump cut) and heavier fall gravity
Contra-style prone: hold down while standing still
8-way aiming with up and down inputs
Held-fire shooting with a configurable fire interval and muzzle marker
Every value is exposed in the Inspector with ranges and tooltips, so it can be tuned live
Sprite-sheet animation for idle (2 random variants), run, sprint, sneak and jump
Leg cycle driven by distance moved, so feet don't slide
Multi-phase jump: take-off, rise, peak, fall, fast fall and landing frames
Placeholder level made from tile-unit rectangles, with ground, walls and platforms
1-tile-thick platforms you can jump through from below
Bullets with lifetime that disappear on world hits
Camera attached to the player
Pixel-perfect 480×270 viewport with integer scaling
Two background images (Soviet sunset street)
